name: Full Efficiency Without Local Strain
purpose: Use more reasoning, broader static analysis, and parallel low-cost checks while avoiding unnecessary CPU, GPU, thermal, browser, build, Docker, or dev-server load.

agentPolicy.pushPolicy: never push until publish preflight and GitHub auth are clean
agentPolicy.reportingPolicy: summarize passed checks, blockers, and next safe slice

usageStewardship.intent: Spend remaining weekly model usage on durable source improvements, not artificial token burn.
preferredSpend: decision records that reduce future prompt repetition
blockedSpend: repeating broad scans after a clean signal
starting dev servers only to consume usage
usageStewardship.stopCondition: Stop when the next safe slice needs secrets, server credentials, or a visual runtime decision.

shipmentLoop.retryPolicy: single attempt only; no retry loop when auth, network, or remote state fails

deliveryLanes.purpose: Keep UI, UX, governance, and source quality moving while GitHub auth or server input is blocked.
deliveryLanes.focus: Improve conversion, accessibility, multilingual clarity, and governance with small static changes.
allowedWork: small reversible UI and content edits
release artifact refresh after source changes

deliveryLanes.purpose: Commit and push only from the real UIXAppTTR Git checkout after preflight passes.
deliveryLanes.focus: Prepare clean local commits and push only after auth and preflight pass.

deliveryLanes.purpose: Prepare server upload bundles without live deployment until target values are explicit.
deliveryLanes.focus: Preserve deployment optionality without forcing live server changes.

deliveryLanes.purpose: Keep the public portfolio contact path clear, accessible, and low-friction.
deliveryLanes.focus: Improve conversion, accessibility, and multilingual clarity with small static changes.

deliveryLanes.purpose: Keep language coverage explainable through manifests, docs, and checks.
deliveryLanes.focus: Expand governed reference lanes only with manifest, docs, checks, and rollback-safe starters.

deliveryLanes.purpose: Mirror local iCloud Git work to the GitHub server only when authentication is ready.
